title: Interest coverage and four-quarter testing period

agreement.pdf.source_wording: The Borrower shall maintain an Interest Coverage Ratio of not less than 3.00:1.00 for each Testing Period.
agreement.pdf.testing_period: The four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on a fiscal quarter end

referenced_definitions.definition_text: Interest Coverage Ratio means EBITDA divided by Interest Expense.
Testing Period means the four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on a fiscal quarter end.
